steps.description:
Time to create a full game with nice graphics! You'll be developing a 2-Player Tic-Tac-Toe game in 3 parts.

In this part, you'll be creating a display for the game Tic-Tac-Toe using Python Turtle. You can enhance the graphics to make it look attractive so that others will like to play your game!

Create a program that performs the following: 1. Draw a 3x3 board similar to the example shown below. It should have a position number in each cell and a label showing "Player-1: X Player-2: O". 2. To test the correctness of the display, the program will repeatedly ask user to input a position (1-9) and either "X" or "O". 3. It will then display the symbol at the position. At this stage, it does not need to check if the position is taken nor if there is a win.

Below shows user running the program twice, once filling up the board with "X" and another with "O" to check that it can display symbols correctly at all positions.


Use functions where applicable to design your solution. Most marks will be given to a good breakdown of codes into functions. Comment your codes.

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

The instructor will test the program
steps.answer:
import turtle

def draw_board(pen):
    pen.speed(0)
    # Draw vertical lines
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-50, 150); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(-50, -150)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(50, 150); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(50, -150)
    # Draw horizontal lines
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-150, 50); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(150, 50)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-150, -50); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(150, -50)
    
    # Draw labels
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(-150, 170)
    pen.write("Player-1: X  Player-2: O", font=("Arial", 16, "normal"))
    
    # Draw positions
    positions = [
        (-100, 100), (0, 100), (100, 100),
        (-100, 0), (0, 0), (100, 0),
        (-100, -100), (0, -100), (100, -100)
    ]
    for i, pos in enumerate(positions):
        pen.penup()
        pen.goto(pos[0]-40, pos[1]+20)
        pen.write(str(i+1), font=("Arial", 10, "normal"))

def draw_symbol(pen, pos_num, symbol):
    positions = [
        (-100, 100), (0, 100), (100, 100),
        (-100, 0), (0, 0), (100, 0),
        (-100, -100), (0, -100), (100, -100)
    ]
    x, y = positions[pos_num - 1]
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(x, y - 20)
    pen.write(symbol, align="center", font=("Arial", 40, "bold"))

screen = turtle.Screen()
pen = turtle.Turtle()
draw_board(pen)

while True:
    try:
        pos = int(input("Enter position (1-9): "))
        sym = input("Enter symbol (X/O): ")
        draw_symbol(pen, pos, sym)
    except:
        break

import turtle

def draw_board(pen):
    pen.speed(0)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-50, 150); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(-50, -150)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(50, 150); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(50, -150)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-150, 50); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(150, 50)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-150, -50); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(150, -50)
    
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(-150, 170)
    pen.write("Player-1: X  Player-2: O", font=("Arial", 16, "normal"))

def draw_symbol(pen, pos_num, symbol):
    positions = [
        (-100, 100), (0, 100), (100, 100),
        (-100, 0), (0, 0), (100, 0),
        (-100, -100), (0, -100), (100, -100)
    ]
    x, y = positions[pos_num - 1]
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(x, y - 20)
    pen.write(symbol, align="center", font=("Arial", 40, "bold"))

def check_win(board):
    win_lines = [
        [0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8], # Horizontal
        [0, 3, 6], [1, 4, 7], [2, 5, 8], # Vertical
        [0, 4, 8], [2, 4, 6]             # Diagonal
    ]
    for line in win_lines:
        if board[line[0]] != 0 and board[line[0]] == board[line[1]] == board[line[2]]:
            return board[line[0]], line
    return None, None

def draw_win_line(pen, line):
    positions = [
        (-100, 100), (0, 100), (100, 100),
        (-100, 0), (0, 0), (100, 0),
        (-100, -100), (0, -100), (100, -100)
    ]
    p1 = positions[line[0]]
    p2 = positions[line[2]]
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(p1)
    pen.pendown()
    pen.pensize(5)
    pen.color("red")
    pen.goto(p2)

screen = turtle.Screen()
pen = turtle.Turtle()
draw_board(pen)

board = [0] * 9
turns = 0
game_over = False

while turns < 9 and not game_over:
    # Player 1
    while True:
        try:
            pos = int(input("Player 1 (X) - Enter position (1-9): "))
            if pos >= 1 and pos <= 9 and board[pos - 1] == 0:
                break
        except:
            pass
    board[pos - 1] = "X"
    draw_symbol(pen, pos, "X")
    turns += 1
    
    winner, line = check_win(board)
    if winner == "X":
        pen.penup()
        pen.goto(0, 200)
        pen.write("PLAYER 1 WINS!!!", align="center", font=("Arial", 20, "bold"))
        draw_win_line(pen, line)
        break
        
    if turns >= 9:
        break
        
    # Player 2
    while True:
        try:
            pos = int(input("Player 2 (O) - Enter position (1-9): "))
            if pos >= 1 and pos <= 9 and board[pos - 1] == 0:
                break
        except:
            pass
    board[pos - 1] = "O"
    draw_symbol(pen, pos, "O")
    turns += 1
    
    winner, line = check_win(board)
    if winner == "O":
        pen.penup()
        pen.goto(0, 200)
        pen.write("PLAYER 2 WINS!!!", align="center", font=("Arial", 20, "bold"))
        draw_win_line(pen, line)
        break

if not winner:
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(0, 200)
    pen.write("IT'S A TIE", align="center", font=("Arial", 20, "bold"))

import turtle

def draw_board(pen):
    pen.speed(0)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-50, 150); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(-50, -150)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(50, 150); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(50, -150)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-150, 50); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(150, 50)
    pen.penup(); pen.goto(-150, -50); pen.pendown(); pen.goto(150, -50)
    
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(-150, 170)
    pen.write("Player-1: X  Player-2: O", font=("Arial", 16, "normal"))

def draw_symbol(pen, pos_num, symbol):
    positions = [
        (-100, 100), (0, 100), (100, 100),
        (-100, 0), (0, 0), (100, 0),
        (-100, -100), (0, -100), (100, -100)
    ]
    x, y = positions[pos_num - 1]
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(x, y - 20)
    pen.write(symbol, align="center", font=("Arial", 40, "bold"))

def check_win(board):
    win_lines = [
        [0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8], # Horizontal
        [0, 3, 6], [1, 4, 7], [2, 5, 8], # Vertical
        [0, 4, 8], [2, 4, 6]             # Diagonal
    ]
    for line in win_lines:
        if board[line[0]] != 0 and board[line[0]] == board[line[1]] == board[line[2]]:
            return board[line[0]], line
    return None, None

def draw_win_line(pen, line):
    positions = [
        (-100, 100), (0, 100), (100, 100),
        (-100, 0), (0, 0), (100, 0),
        (-100, -100), (0, -100), (100, -100)
    ]
    p1 = positions[line[0]]
    p2 = positions[line[2]]
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(p1)
    pen.pendown()
    pen.pensize(5)
    pen.color("red")
    pen.goto(p2)

screen = turtle.Screen()
pen = turtle.Turtle()
draw_board(pen)

board = [0] * 9
turns = 0
game_over = False

while turns < 9 and not game_over:
    # Player 1
    while True:
        try:
            pos = int(input("Player 1 (X) - Enter position (1-9): "))
            if pos >= 1 and pos <= 9 and board[pos - 1] == 0:
                break
        except:
            pass
    board[pos - 1] = "X"
    draw_symbol(pen, pos, "X")
    turns += 1
    
    winner, line = check_win(board)
    if winner == "X":
        pen.penup()
        pen.goto(0, 200)
        pen.write("PLAYER 1 WINS!!!", align="center", font=("Arial", 20, "bold"))
        draw_win_line(pen, line)
        break
        
    if turns >= 9:
        break
        
    # Player 2
    while True:
        try:
            pos = int(input("Player 2 (O) - Enter position (1-9): "))
            if pos >= 1 and pos <= 9 and board[pos - 1] == 0:
                break
        except:
            pass
    board[pos - 1] = "O"
    draw_symbol(pen, pos, "O")
    turns += 1
    
    winner, line = check_win(board)
    if winner == "O":
        pen.penup()
        pen.goto(0, 200)
        pen.write("PLAYER 2 WINS!!!", align="center", font=("Arial", 20, "bold"))
        draw_win_line(pen, line)
        break

if not winner:
    pen.penup()
    pen.goto(0, 200)
    pen.write("IT'S A TIE", align="center", font=("Arial", 20, "bold"))
